mentions.name: G-code Sender (mycnc.app)
mentions.description: A g-code sender for CNC machines, developed to complement the author's browser-based CNC simulator.
mentions.problem: CNC software is considerably more complex than today's 3D printer software, making hobby CNC harder to pick up.
